macros.name: baseclass
macros.doc: You may change the baseclass by defining the macro \baseclass.

macros.name: date
macros.doc: In the standard LaTeX 2ε classes the command is used to specify the date of the document: \date{⟨date⟩}. In fbithesis the macro is enhanced by an optional argument to specify the period of the thesis: \date[⟨begin date⟩]{⟨end date⟩}.

macros.name: date
macros.doc: In the standard LaTeX 2ε classes the command is used to specify the date of the document: \date{⟨date⟩}. In fbithesis the macro is enhanced by an optional argument to specify the period of the thesis: \date[⟨begin date⟩]{⟨end date⟩}.

macros.name: subject
macros.doc: By the command \subject{⟨sub⟩} you may provide the ‘type’ of the thesis (like ‘Diplomarbeit’, or ‘Dissertation’).

macros.name: supervisors
macros.doc: The supervisors of the thesis may be provided by \supervisors{⟨first supervisor⟩}{⟨second supervisor⟩}.

macros.name: thesislogo
macros.doc: You may use the command \thesislogo if you want to place a thesis-specific logo on the title page.

macros.name: titlevadjust
macros.doc: Positive values for \titlevadjust{⟨length⟩} move the page up, negative values down.

macros.name: unidologo
macros.doc: By using the command \unidologo{⟨filename⟩} you may include the logo of the TU Dortmund to the title page.
